correctness.rationale: Fully quantified n>=4; explicit four residue constructions; deletion shadows disjoint by mandatory four-position shift and repeated 11 obstruction. The exact 64-state deterministic recognizer has a mathematically justified NFA transition and counts distinct outputs. Matrix orbit has dimension 4096 and finite check of 4099 terms per residue proves equality for all lengths by Cayley–Hamilton plus cubic annihilator. C++ source compiled/executed with 4x4099 successful comparisons; independent direct set enumerator checks all 43942 unordered pairs through n=8 and the family through n=14. Arithmetic is exact with a conservative path-count bound excluding overflow. No unproved global optimality asserted.

value.rationale: Solves an exact infinite-family mixed-edit intersection with an explicit quadratic ambiguity obstruction for centers separated enough to correct a deletion. This directly addresses the gap left by the 2016 distance-one construction in an established reconstruction problem. It is not merely a small finite or arbitrary-parameter count. Scope remains a natural two-codeword lower-bound witness, not code capacity or global intersection maximum.
